source_summary: Vertical Chinese ink landscape with upper inscriptions excluded; motifs are drawn from the lower landscape area: misty mountains, lake flats, groves, a small pavilion, and foreground banks rendered in layered ink washes.

motifs.name: hazy_background_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the soft distant mountain silhouettes behind the main ridge, including the rounded central peak and paler left foothills fading into atmosphere.

motifs.name: left_rocky_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the dark, textured middle-distance ridge stretching from the left edge toward the center, with craggy summit, sloping shoulders, and layered foothills.

motifs.name: right_low_lakeshore_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant hills and shoreline on the right side of the lake, including the small pointed hill and faint horizontal shore bands.
must_preserve: soft mist gap between hill layers

motifs.name: central_lake_mist_water
motifs.description: Isolate the open lake and mist field across the center, preserving the pale water plane, faint banks, and horizontal ripples visible between mountains and foreground trees.
must_preserve: small broken bank strokes and tiny rock marks

motifs.name: left_flowering_willow_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground cluster of pale flowering or leafy trees and drooping willow-like branches, including the looping round foliage marks and thin bending stems.

motifs.name: central_tall_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the central grove of tall trunks and dark foliage masses rising in front of the lake, excluding the pavilion where possible but retaining trunks that define the grove.
must_preserve: layered foliage silhouettes with varied ink density

motifs.name: secluded_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion or house nestled among trees near the lower center-right, including its simple roof, gable, walls, doorway lines, and visible structural strokes.
must_preserve: dark ink accents where tree trunks overlap the structure

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground landform with rounded rocky bank, right-side stones, grass and reed strokes, and shallow water at the base; exclude seals near the corners.
must_preserve: broad curved wash forming the bank
small rock outlines on the right
short reed and grass strokes along the water edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
